name: zk-threat-exchange - SOC Phishing Alert Relay
author: Ciprian Ștefan Pleșca
description: Watches the enterprise-api /v1/commitments feed for new high-corroboration commitments and relays a notification to a SOC inbox/Slack channel, without ever handling the underlying raw witness data.

flow.name: Receive zk-threat-exchange commitment
flow.notes: Point this at enterprise-api's outbound webhook (configure in dashboard: Settings > Webhooks). Payload matches the ThreatCommitment JSON shape from internal/handlers/handlers.go.

template.subject: [zk-threat-exchange] New corroborated threat commitment

flow.name: Post to #soc-alerts
flow.text: 🔺 New corroborated threat commitment `{{commitment}}` ({{corroborations}} peers). See dashboard for details.

notes: Import via Make.com > Scenarios > Import Blueprint. Requires a free Make.com account; no cost to run this automation for low-volume alerting tiers.
